versions.changelog:
thesis-review v2.1.0

- Unified the review framework by merging thesis-review-pro (v2.0) with thesis-review (v1.0).
- Added reference documents with common review patterns and templates.
- Updated the main skill documentation with a multi-dimensional evaluation system, criteria checklists, and detailed output requirements.
- Enhanced support for batch review and innovation scoring rubrics.
- Removed outdated files and consolidated all guidance into a single, comprehensive workflow.

- Initial release of "thesis-review": A structured tool for generating professional master's thesis review reports based on user-provided thesis text or PDF.
- Automatically collects core thesis information (title, author, institution, etc.) and deeply analyzes all main sections.
- Produces detailed, actionable review comments using a standardized template covering strengths, weaknesses, and improvement suggestions.
- Ensures problem descriptions and suggestions are clear, matched, and specific for every issue found.
- Outputs the review in both Markdown (for chat display) and as a formatted Word (.docx) file, following strict formatting and naming conventions.
- Handles special cases such as partial thesis submissions or non-expert fields with adaptive review output and transparent reviewer notes.
